title: Probing the Gaps in ChatGPT Live Video Chat for Real-World Assistance for People who are Blind or Visually Impaired

bias_targets.methodology: An exploratory in-person user study with 8 blind or visually impaired (BVI) participants interacting with ChatGPT's live video AI across various real-world scenarios (e.g., object understanding, indoor/outdoor navigation). The study identifies how the model incorrectly assumes users have visual abilities, provides visual-centric guidance, and fails to adapt to explicitly stated visual impairments.
